Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kalyan Dombivli

Kalyan and Dombivli sit about 28 km from our factory in Vasai, which makes the twin city one of the closest large markets we serve. FunPlay Systems has made outdoor playground equipment since 2002. Every slide, swing and play tower for Kalyan Dombivli is built in our own 45,000 sq ft unit and then travels by road to your site.

Most enquiries from here come from builders finishing new towers, from older societies that are being redeveloped and want a fresh garden, and from schools along the Central Railway line. We help each of them choose equipment, mark the safe play area on a layout drawing and install the pieces with our own team. Most projects start with a phone call and a few photos.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karaikudi

Karaikudi is the main town of Chettinad, known for its grand old mansions, Athangudi tiles and the heritage hotels that now occupy some of those houses. Schools and new housing in the town also ask us for play areas. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,210 km away, and sends it to Tamil Nadu by road.

A heritage property needs a gentle approach. Old floors and courtyards should not be dug up or drilled, and a brightly coloured play tower can look out of place against carved wood and tiled verandahs. We usually suggest placing the play area in a side garden or rear courtyard, away from the main view, and using self-standing installation on any paved surface. Elsewhere in the state, we have installed a resort playground in Dindigul.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karawal Nagar

Karawal Nagar is a densely built part of north-east Delhi, close to the Yamuna and the Uttar Pradesh border. Open space is scarce, so the few parks and school grounds in the area carry a lot of children every evening. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these sites at our factory in Vasai, about 1,130 km away, and sends it to Delhi by road.

In a small, busy park, the question to ask of each piece is how many children it can hold at once. A single swing serves one child at a time, while a four-seat see-saw or a four-seater merry-go-round keeps a whole group busy. We help residents' welfare associations and schools choose equipment by that measure, so queues stay short and quarrels fewer. Delhi's hot summers and smoggy winters also call for materials that are easy to wash clean.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karimnagar

Karimnagar, in northern Telangana on the Manair river, is known for its granite quarries and its silver filigree work. Granite is everywhere in the town, including the paving of many school courtyards, society gardens and parks. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for these sites from our factory in Vasai, about 660 km away, delivered by road.

Stone paving looks neat and needs little upkeep, but it is one of the hardest surfaces a child can fall on. Some older play areas in the region have swings and slides set straight onto granite or tiles. If yours is one of them, the paving may not need to come up at all. Rubber flooring can often be laid over a sound, level paved surface, with the equipment self-standing on its base or fixed in the way the site needs.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karnataka & Andhra Pradesh

FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to builders, schools, housing societies, resorts and municipal parks across Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. The two states cover very different ground, from Bengaluru's apartment towers and the wet Karnataka coast to the dry interior and the long Andhra coastline on the Bay of Bengal.

All our equipment is made at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, with in-house design, roto-moulding and fabrication. We send it south by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it, self-standing or grouted. In Bengaluru most enquiries come from gated communities and schools. Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubballi and Belagavi have schools and city parks. In Andhra Pradesh, Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur, Nellore and Tirupati have growing housing projects and schools. Send us the site size, the age group and photos, and we will draw a layout with the safe play area marked.

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Katihar

Katihar is a railway junction town in north-east Bihar, in the low country between the Ganga and the rivers that come down from Nepal. Floods are part of life in this region, and school grounds and colony parks can stay under water for days. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for these sites from our factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and sends it by road.

Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts come through standing water well, but a flood leaves behind silt, debris and loosened ground. The equipment should be checked before children use it again, however sound it looks. Our after-sales team can guide your staff through that check. If something has been damaged, send us photos and we will advise on repair or replacement parts. When planning a new play area here, also raise its base above the usual flood level where the site allows.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Katni

Katni, in the Mahakoshal region of Madhya Pradesh, is a railway junction known for its limestone and cement industry, and is often called the lime city. Colony parks, factory townships and schools here ask us for play areas, and many want something for adults too. FunPlay Systems makes both playground and outdoor gym equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 920 km away, and sends it by road.

A park where parents can exercise while their children play tends to be used more often than one built for children alone. Our Fun Fitness range includes outdoor gym machines such as walkers, twisters and leg presses, which can sit beside the play area. We plan both on one layout drawing, with separate zones and a clear path between them. Katni's summers are hot and its monsoon steady, so we plan shade and drainage for both zones.

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kerala & Tamil Nadu

FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment across Kerala and Tamil Nadu, from apartment projects in Kochi and Chennai to schools in Madurai and Coimbatore and resorts in the hills. We design and make every piece at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, where we have worked since 2002. The equipment reaches the south by road and is installed by our own team or a dealer in the region.

The two states share a long coastline and two monsoons, yet the conditions on a site in Alappuzha are very different from those in Tiruchirappalli or Ooty. Humidity and salt air decide the choice of materials on the coast, while the dry interior of Tamil Nadu raises questions of heat and shade. Hill sites need a firm base on sloping ground. We plan each layout with these differences in mind, and send a drawing with the safe play area marked before anything is made.

How would you like to start?

Top Factors Which Make Us a Leading Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer in Kerala?

Different types of play systems

We make a wide range of products for small parks, gardens, outdoor areas, and spaces. We design the equipment that fits in every area. Apart from that, our team visits the area and takes accurate measurements. They build a high standard of products as per the demands of the clients. We manufacture the playground equipment for age starting from 4 years to 10 years.

Timely installation

Our efficient team has been appreciated for punctuality and timely services. We try our best to complete every project within the given time. In addition to that, being the most trusted Outdoor Playground Equipment manufacturer in Kerala we follow every instruction of the clients and work according to their choice. There is no delay in our service and clients choose us for our accurate services.

Durability of the products

The long-lasting products make us the leading Outdoor Playground Equipment manufacturer in Kerala. We build products using tested materials. Apart from that, we also take care of quality at every stage of the manufacturing cycle. Our products remain in good condition even after many years. They do not break or damage due to wind force, rainwater, snowfall, or other environmental hazards.

Safe equipment

We pick good raw materials to design outdoor playground tools. After deciding the raw materials, our technicians also check them in our plant. Our products are safe for all children. They do not get injuries by using our playground equipment. Furthermore, our tools do not harm the environment or pollute the air in any way.

Manufacture all the playgrounds

Whether it is Public Park, Fun Park,school or outdoor areas, we design play systems for every playground. We manufacture the products after knowing the needs and budget of the clients. Our products include merry go round, climbing frames, spring rockers, Slides, Tots world and so on. They fit in any area and on any type of ground.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kharagpur

Kharagpur is a railway town with one of the longest railway platforms in India, a large railway workshop and an IIT campus, with an air force station nearby. Its campuses and railway colonies have wide roads, cycle tracks and a lot of traffic moving between them. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for these sites from our factory in Vasai, about 1,530 km away, and sends it to West Bengal by road.

On a campus or colony with constant cycle and scooter traffic, the boundary of the play area matters as much as the equipment inside it. Children leave a swing or slide at speed and rarely look before running. We plan the layout so that exits face away from roads and paths, with a hedge, fence or open lawn between the play area and moving traffic. The climate here is hot and humid, with a heavy monsoon, so drainage gets attention too.

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Khora, Ghaziabad

Khora, on the Ghaziabad side of the Noida border, is one of the most densely built areas in the National Capital Region. Open ground is scarce, so a play area here usually has to fit into a school courtyard, a society corner or a small park. FunPlay Systems designs equipment that works in such spaces and supplies it from our factory in Vasai, about 1,120 km away.

We have been manufacturing outdoor playground equipment since 2002. For Khora and the rest of Ghaziabad we send the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in north India. You share the plot size and a few photos, and we reply with a layout drawing that shows how much safe play area each piece needs.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer & Supplier of Outdoor Play Equipment

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,110 km away, with galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic chosen for exactly these conditions.

We supply apartment builders in Kakkanad, Edappally and the suburbs, schools across Ernakulam district, and resorts and homestays that want a play corner for visiting families. The equipment goes from Vasai by road and is installed by our team or a dealer in the south. Since 2002 we have completed more than 15,000 installations across India, and the same process and warranty apply to a site in Kochi as to one near our factory.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kohima

Very little flat land exists in Kohima. Schools, churches, colonies and offices in the Nagaland capital sit along ridges and slopes. A playground here usually has to be planned around a terrace or a cut in the hillside. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment at Vasai, near Mumbai, roughly 2,300 km away, and supplies sites across the north-east by road.

Because the distance is long, we spend more time on planning before anything is made. Send us photos of the site taken from a few angles, the measurements of the flat area you have and the age group of the children. We will suggest equipment that fits a terrace and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing. Installation is handled by our team or a dealer in the region.

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kolkata

In Kolkata, a neighbourhood park is often used for much more than play. The same ground may host football in the evening, a puja pandal in autumn and a winter fair. FunPlay Systems plans outdoor playground equipment with that kind of shared use in mind. We supply parks, schools and housing complexes across the city from our factory in Vasai, about 1,640 km away.

We have designed and manufactured play equipment since 2002, with in-house roto-moulding and fabrication. For Kolkata, the equipment travels by road and our installation team or a dealer in east India sets it up. Before anything is made, you receive a layout drawing that shows each piece and the safe play area around it.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Lucknow

Lucknow has large, planned colonies such as Gomti Nagar, Aliganj and Indira Nagar, each with neighbourhood parks, and a strong base of private schools. Both need outdoor playground equipment that copes with a scorching summer, a damp monsoon and cold, foggy winters. FunPlay Systems makes that equipment at our factory in Vasai and sends it about 1,170 km by road to Lucknow.

We have been designing and manufacturing play equipment since 2002, with our own design, roto-moulding and fabrication teams. In Lucknow, installation is done by our team or a dealer in north India. We start with your site size, the age group and a few photos, and we reply with a layout and a quote. From there, we manufacture, dispatch and install.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Madurai

Madurai is one of Tamil Nadu's oldest cities. It grew around the Meenakshi Amman Temple and is today a large education centre for the south of the state, with schools and colleges drawing students from many districts. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to its schools, colleges, housing projects and parks from our factory in Vasai, about 1,190 km away.

We have worked in this part of Tamil Nadu before, with a resort playground in Dindigul, a short drive north of the city. Equipment for Madurai travels by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the south puts it in place. We have been designing and manufacturing play equipment since 2002. Every project starts with a layout and a quote based on your site photos.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Manipur

FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, community grounds, parks and housing colonies in Manipur. Level open ground is easiest to find in the Imphal valley and the towns around it, such as Thoubal and Bishnupur. We also supply district headquarters in the surrounding hills, where sites are smaller and need more planning.

All equipment is built at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and sent to Manipur by road. A local dealer or our own installation team then installs it, self-standing or grouted depending on the ground. Schools, churches and local clubs in the state often share one ground for play, sport and community events. We plan the playground in a corner that does not get in the way of football or gatherings. We also mark the safe play area on a layout drawing so everyone can see the space it needs.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Meerut

Meerut makes a large share of India's sports goods, from cricket bats to footballs, and its schools and cantonment colonies take outdoor activity seriously. Older children here quickly outgrow toddler slides and spring riders, and they want something that tests strength and balance. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,170 km away, and sends it to western UP by road.

We supply schools, societies, clubs and public parks across Meerut. Tell us the age group, the size of the space and how many children play at once. We will propose equipment with the safe play area marked on a layout drawing, and once you approve the layout and quote, our team or a dealer in north India installs it.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mizoram

Most playgrounds we plan for Mizoram sit inside a school, church or community compound, because that is where level ground and supervision already exist. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for these sites in Aizawl, Lunglei, Champhai and the smaller district towns. A compound playground is usually shared by toddlers after church, schoolchildren at recess and older children in the evening, so the equipment list has to work for all three groups.

We make every piece at our factory in Vasai, Palghar district, Maharashtra, and send it to Mizoram by road. Our installation team or a local dealer installs it, grouted into concrete on firm ground or self-standing on a prepared base. Start by sending us the length and width of the open space, photos taken from two or three corners and the ages of the children who will use it. We reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing that shows the safe play area for each piece.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nagaland

Children in Nagaland's hill towns often have one shared ground for play, sport and community events, so a playground here has to be compact, sturdy and placed with care. FunPlay Systems designs and builds outdoor playground equipment for schools, churches, village and town councils, government quarters and parks in Kohima, Dimapur, Mokokchung, Wokha and other district towns.

Everything is made at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, using galvanised steel, roto-moulded plastic and, in some ranges, wood and composite panels. We dispatch by road, and our installation team or a local dealer fixes the equipment on your site, self-standing or grouted depending on the ground. You can choose from more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades, which helps when a school wants its playground to match its uniform or building colours. Send the site size, a few photos and the age group, and we will reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nagpur

Nagpur summers are among the hottest in India, and anyone planning a playground here should start with the sun. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Nagpur's schools, housing societies and public gardens from our factory in Vasai, about 670 km away on the other side of Maharashtra.

We have been making play equipment since 2002 and have more than 15,000 installations across India. For Nagpur and the wider Vidarbha region, we send the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer. Before we manufacture anything, you see a layout drawing with the safe play area marked for every piece, so the committee can approve the plan knowing how much space it needs.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nashik

Nashik has grown fast along the Mumbai highway, with new housing on the city's edges and a wide spread of schools. It also draws a steady flow of pilgrims to the Godavari ghats and to Trimbakeshwar nearby. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to all of these from our factory in Vasai, about 120 km away.

That short distance helps. Our equipment reaches Nashik by road and is installed by our team or a dealer near you, using the self-standing or grouting method that suits the ground. We have been manufacturing play equipment since 2002, with design, roto-moulding and fabrication done in our own factory. Many Nashik projects begin with a phone call and a few photos of the site.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panaji

Digging, grouting and laying flooring in steady rain is slow and the concrete does not set well. Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panihati

A playground quotation can look simple, a list of items and a total, but two offers with the same items can mean very different things. Buyers in Panihati and the towns along the Hooghly north of Kolkata often send us a competing quote and ask why the prices differ. The answer is usually in the details the quote leaves out.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our own factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and sends it to West Bengal by road. Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panipat

Panipat is known as a city of weavers, and its mills turn yarn and old textiles into rugs, blankets and furnishings sold around the world. People here understand rope, fibre and wear better than most. So it is fair that Panipat buyers ask how the rope and nets on a playground climber are made, and how long they will last.

FunPlay Systems makes climbers, nets and play structures at our factory in Vasai, about 1,190 km from Panipat. Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Parbhani

Much of Parbhani district sits on the black cotton soil of the Marathwada plateau. It is good farmland, but it swells when it soaks up monsoon rain and shrinks and cracks when it dries in summer. That movement can tilt or loosen a playground post set into it without the right base, so the ground deserves attention before the equipment is chosen.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 410 km from Parbhani. We send it by road within Maharashtra, where we have also installed a playground for Raymond in Thane. Our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment at schools, colleges, societies and public gardens. Send us photos of your ground, ideally one taken in the dry season, along with the size and the age group. We will suggest an installation method and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Patna

Patna has a large number of private schools, and several of them run more than one branch across the city and in nearby towns. When a school group sets up new playgrounds, it often wants every campus to look and work the same way, so that parents recognise the school and staff follow one maintenance routine. Planning several sites at once is something we can help with.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,430 km from Patna, and sends it to Bihar by road. Our installation team or a Bihar dealer sets it up. We also supply housing societies, apartment builders and parks along the Ganga. Send us the size of each campus play area, the age groups and photos. We will prepare a layout drawing for each site with the safe play area marked.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer & Supplier of Outdoor Play Equipment

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pimpri Chinchwad

Pimpri Chinchwad grew around factories, and many of its residential areas started as housing for people working in the automobile and engineering units of Bhosari, Chinchwad and the nearby industrial belt. Today the city also has large new housing projects in Wakad, Ravet, Punawale and Moshi. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to both, from our factory in Vasai East, about 130 km away.

We understand buyers who think like engineers, because we fabricate our own frames and roto-mould our own parts. Since 2002 we have built play equipment for schools, builders, companies and public bodies across India. For a Pimpri Chinchwad site, we send the equipment by road and install it with our team or a local dealer.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Puducherry & Lakshadweep

Puducherry and Lakshadweep are both small, both on the sea and both humid all year, but they are planned very differently. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, resorts, hotels, housing projects and public gardens in Puducherry, and to island sites in Lakshadweep that need extra planning for transport.

Lakshadweep sites are mostly schools, government campuses and island resorts. For both, we make the equipment at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. For Puducherry it goes by road and is installed by our team or a dealer in south India. Island orders also need sea transport from the mainland, so speak to our sales team early and we will work out packing and installation with you before you confirm.

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pune

Pune has more schools, colleges and new housing projects than most cities its size, and a large share of our Maharashtra enquiries come from here. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, about 140 km away. We send it over the ghats by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer.

Buyers in Pune tend to arrive with a clear brief. An architect may have marked the play area on a master plan, or a school may have a fixed ground and an age group in mind. We work from that brief, suggest equipment and send a drawing with the safe play area for each piece, so you can check the fit before you approve a quote.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Raipur

Raipur is the capital of Chhattisgarh, and with Nava Raipur rising on its eastern side, the city has new government campuses, public spaces and housing projects that need play areas. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, about 930 km away, and sends it east by road through Vidarbha.

We have been designing and manufacturing play equipment since 2002 and have more than 15,000 installations across India. In Raipur, installation is done by our own team or a dealer in central India. Schools, housing societies, builders and municipal bodies all start the same way. Send us the site size, the age group and a few photos, and we reply with a layout drawing and a quote.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

!-- start section -->

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rajasthan

Rajasthan asks more of outdoor equipment than most states. Summer afternoons in the Thar are among the hottest in India, dust storms sweep across the west before the monsoon, and desert nights in winter turn cold. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures playground equipment that is chosen and placed with these conditions in mind. We supply schools, resorts, housing projects and public gardens across the state from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra.

The equipment travels north by road through Gujarat and is installed by our own team or a dealer in the region. We have been making play equipment since 2002, with design, roto-moulding and fabrication done in-house. Our galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic stand up to heat, dust and the short, heavy rains. Every project begins with your site size, the age group and photos, and a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sambalpur

Sambalpur, on the Mahanadi in western Odisha, is known for the Hirakud dam and for its handwoven Sambalpuri textiles. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, colonies and parks in the city and across the district. We build it at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,180 km away, and send it by road for installation.

Western Odisha has some of the hottest summers in eastern India, and that affects the colours you should choose. Dark plastic left in direct sun heats up quickly, while lighter shades stay cooler. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades, so you can pick a scheme that looks bright and still works in April and May. Send us the site details and we will suggest equipment and colours together.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sambhal

A school or colony in Sambhal that orders playground equipment from us usually wants to know one thing first: how does it reach a town this size, and who puts it up? FunPlay Systems builds every piece at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,170 km away. It travels by road to your site, and our installation team or a dealer in north India fixes it in place.

Sambhal sits in the western Uttar Pradesh plains, between Moradabad and Badaun, and is known for its horn and bone handicrafts. Summers here are very hot and winters bring fog and cold mornings, so we suggest galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic for most sites. Send us the size of your ground, the age of the children and a few photos. We will reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing that marks the safe play area.

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sangli-Miraj-Kupwad

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers in Surat

A Surat builder selling flats in a new tower wants a play area that looks good on the brochure. It also has to hold up to daily use once residents move in. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for these projects, and for schools and gardens, at our factory in Vasai East, about 200 km away down the coast.

Surat is known for diamond cutting and textiles, and new residential towers keep coming up across the city. It is humid, close to the sea and gets a heavy monsoon from June to September. Share your amenity plan, the size of the play area and the age group you expect. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, ready for your architect.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thane

Thane is about 20 km from our factory in Vasai East, closer than any other large city we serve. It is also where we installed play equipment for Raymond, so a Thane buyer can see our work in their own city. FunPlay Systems has designed and manufactured outdoor playground equipment since 2002, and every piece for Thane is made in our 45,000 sq ft unit.

The city has two very different kinds of sites. The old centre around the lakes has established societies with small gardens and equipment that is due for replacement. Along Ghodbunder Road and Pokhran Road, large townships plan play areas that serve hundreds of families. We work with both, and with the schools and municipal gardens in between.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thiruvananthapuram

Office campuses at Technopark and the government offices of the state capital employ many young parents, and some now run creches or day-care centres with a small outdoor play area. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these, as well as for schools, apartment projects and city parks in Thiruvananthapuram. Everything is made at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,290 km away.

Kerala's capital gets rain from two monsoons, the south-west from June and the north-east from October, and sites near Kovalam and Shanghumugham also get salt air. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit this weather. Our team or a dealer in south India installs the equipment once it reaches the city by road. Send the size of the outdoor space and the ages of the children in the day-care, and we will reply with a layout drawing.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thoothukudi

Thoothukudi is a port city with salt pans along its coast, and both put salt into the air that settles on anything left outdoors. Bare steel near the sea starts to rust quickly here. FunPlay Systems builds outdoor playground equipment for schools, port and industrial colonies, and parks in Thoothukudi at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,310 km away.

The city is hot and fairly dry for most of the year, with most of its rain from October to December. The finished pieces reach Thoothukudi by road, and our own team or a south Indian dealer installs them. Tell us how far your site is from the sea and send a few photos. We will pick materials and a layout to suit, with the safe play area marked on the drawing.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tinsukia

Tea estates around Tinsukia often run their own schools and look after the welfare of families in the garden lines, and a playground is a common request. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for estate schools and colonies, as well as for town schools, oil and railway colonies and parks in Tinsukia. Everything comes from our factory in Vasai East, about 2,460 km away.

Upper Assam is one of the wettest parts of the country, with heavy rain from about April to October and cool winters. Estate sites can be a long way down unpaved roads. The equipment goes by road all the way to Upper Assam, where our own team or a dealer in eastern India installs it. Share photos of the site and of the approach road, and we will plan the delivery along with the layout drawing.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tiruchirappalli

When the bell rings for the break in a large Tiruchirappalli school, hundreds of children can reach the playground within a few minutes. The equipment has to give them all something to do without a crowd on one slide. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colleges, colonies and parks in Trichy at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,140 km away.

Trichy is one of Tamil Nadu's main education centres, with the Rockfort at its heart and Srirangam across the Kaveri. Summers are long and hot, and most of the rain comes from October to December. We truck the equipment to Trichy and install it with our own crew or a dealer in south India. Tell us how many children use the ground at one time, and we will plan the equipment around that number on a layout drawing.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tirunelveli

From June to September, strong winds blow across the plains of southern Tamil Nadu, which is why the country around Tirunelveli is dotted with wind turbines. Those winds matter when you put up a playground with roofs, panels and swings. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colleges, colonies and parks in Tirunelveli at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,290 km away.

Tirunelveli sits on the Thamirabarani river and is known for its halwa and the Nellaiappar temple. It is hot for most of the year, with the main rain from October to December. Equipment reaches Tirunelveli by road, and installation is done by our own team or a dealer in the south. Send us photos of the site and tell us which way the wind usually comes from, and we will plan the layout with that in mind.

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tiruvottiyur

Tiruvottiyur, on the northern seafront of Chennai, mixes older streets, industrial units near the ports and newer apartment blocks. Builders here need a play area that holds up to inspection when the flats are handed over to the residents' association. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these projects, and for schools and parks, at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,050 km away.

The area comes under the Greater Chennai Corporation and shares the city's hot, humid weather and north-east monsoon from October to December. Sites close to the shore also get salt air. We send equipment by road and install through our own team or a dealer in south India. Share the size of the play area and your expected handover month, and we will plan the order around that date.

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tripura

Tripura is a small, green state bordered by Bangladesh on most sides, and our playground buyers here are mostly schools, municipal and town parks, government campuses and residential colonies. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for Agartala, Udaipur, Dharmanagar, Kailashahar and the other district towns.

Agartala has the widest mix of sites, from city parks and lakeside gardens to private schools and new housing. Udaipur is a temple town, and parks there see families on festival days. In smaller towns the school ground is often the only proper play space, so durable equipment that many children can share is the priority. Our equipment is made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and reaches Tripura by road through Assam. Our installation team or a local dealer installs it, grouted or self-standing depending on the soil. Tell us the size of your site and the age groups, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ulhasnagar

Many housing societies in Ulhasnagar still have the playground they got when the building was new: a rusted slide, a swing with a cracked seat and bare ground underneath. FunPlay Systems replaces such play areas with new outdoor playground equipment, made at our factory in Vasai East, only about 30 km away. We also supply schools, gardens and new building projects in the town.

Ulhasnagar sits between Kalyan and Ambarnath in Thane district, a dense trading town where open space is precious. It shares the Mumbai region's heavy monsoon from June to September. With the factory this close, the equipment makes a short road trip, and our installation team or a local dealer fixes it on site. Send us photos of the old equipment and the space around it, and we will plan the new pieces on a layout drawing.

Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Unnao

On a small school ground in Unnao, the temptation is to fit in one more swing. The space around each piece matters as much as the piece itself, because a child who walks into the path of a moving swing can be badly hurt. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colonies and parks in Unnao at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,110 km away, and marks that space on every layout drawing.

Unnao lies between Kanpur and Lucknow in central Uttar Pradesh, with leather and industrial units along the highway and many schools in the town and district. Summers are very hot, winters are cold and foggy, and the monsoon runs from late June to September. The equipment travels by road and is installed by our team or a dealer in north India. Share the length and width of your ground, and we will show how many pieces fit safely.

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Vijayawada

Vijayawada lies on the Krishna river, a busy commercial and education city in coastal Andhra Pradesh, with Guntur and the state capital region close by. Its schools, apartment projects and public gardens need play equipment that copes with fierce summer heat and the heavy rain that cyclones from the Bay of Bengal can bring. FunPlay Systems supplies them from our factory in Vasai East, about 880 km away.

We have designed and manufactured outdoor playground equipment since 2002. For Vijayawada, the equipment goes by road and is installed by our own team or a dealer in south India. You tell us the site size and the children's age group and send photos, and we reply with suggested equipment, a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and a quote.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Yamunanagar

Yamunanagar is one of India's main plywood and timber centres, so buyers here know wood well and often ask whether a playground can be made of it. Some of ours are. FunPlay Systems makes wooden play structures in our NexLev range, along with galvanised steel and roto-moulded equipment, at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,280 km away.

The city lies in northern Haryana near the Shivalik foothills, beside the Yamuna, with hot summers, a monsoon from July to September and cold, foggy winters. We supply schools, colonies, factory campuses and parks here, with equipment sent by road and installed by our team or a dealer in north India. Tell us whether you prefer wood, plastic or a mix, and we will suggest pieces on a layout drawing.

body:
Multi Play Fun System

Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mumbai

Our factory in Vasai East sits just north of Mumbai, so the city is home ground for us. FunPlay Systems has designed and manufactured outdoor playground equipment since 2002, and everything we supply to Mumbai is made in our own 45,000 sq ft unit, then delivered by road and installed by our team.

Mumbai sites are rarely simple. Gardens are small, podium play areas sit on top of parking levels, the monsoon is heavy and long, and in the western suburbs the sea air is never far away. We plan equipment, materials and layouts around those limits, for housing societies, schools, builders and municipal gardens across the city and suburbs.

How would you like to start?

Turn your playground dreams to reality
CoreCraft

Strength Redefined
Funplay Originals

Unique Play Experiences
Nexlev Series

Advanced Play Solutions

Why choose us?

1. Made in our own factory

We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

2. Three product ranges

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

3. Materials that suit Indian weather

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.

4. Reasonable rates

We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

5. Support after installation

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

6. Equipment for every age group

We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.

7. 15,000+ installations

Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.

Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment
